title: A Trip to Moscow
subtitle: 考点：一般过去时 / 旅行经历 / be surprised
passage: Last summer, Ben went to Moscow with his parents. It was his first trip to Russia. They stayed in a small hotel near Red Square. The hotel was comfortable, and the people there were very friendly.

On the second day, they took the metro. Ben was surprised because the stations looked like palaces. There were beautiful lights and artworks on the walls. He said that the metro was not like any metro at home.
In the evening, they walked in Red Square. A man was playing the accordion, and many people were taking photos. The view took Ben's breath away. He thought, “I will never forget this trip.”
vocab: hotel 旅馆 · comfortable 舒适的 · metro 地铁 · palace 宫殿 · accordion 手风琴 · surprised 惊讶的 · forget 忘记
